existingGeometryReuse.conclusion: Approved donor paths are geometry material only. 院 and 河/何 could supply left-radical/right-component geometry, and 免/逸 contain related shapes, but none establishes the complete 阿 or 兔 order, direction or glyph form. Prefer the exact Ja8 阿 candidate if the independent source review passes; do not construct 兔 to overcome an unresolved source conflict.

constraints.finding: Review validation is specifically bound to Vivasam ID, XLSX manifest SHA, row and video filename, row-derived MP4 URL, video-frame-sequence method, duration, per-stroke completion times, all four match checks and final path hash. Static PDF evidence cannot satisfy it honestly.
Discovery, review records and published sourceReference all require the Vivasam manifest. The top-level bundle also labels every emitted entry as Vivasam. There is no document-source branch.
Recipes bind sourceVideoSha256. Changing that field to mean a PDF would misrepresent provenance; broad canonical-format changes would alter existing recipe pins.

Authored geometry and donor provenance are also video-bound. Existing approved donor paths never authorize a new whole glyph. A Ja8 阿 candidate makes an authored-registry extension unnecessary for this batch.
The publisher union currently allows only vivasam-high-2022. Playback resolves an explicit registered glyph and matching path count; keep that fail-closed lookup.

The validation dispatch, evidence reporting and verification-source counts recognize only Vivasam as textbook evidence. A new document branch must not fall through to the Eomunhoe checks or be counted as exam-body approval.

recommendedMinimalDesign.runtimeWiring: Load a separate small document-reviewed bundle and append it explicitly to HANJA_STROKES; keep the existing 969-entry Vivasam bundle and all 503 exam-body entries intact. Update the general audit source dispatch/counts for the document branch.
recommendedMinimalDesign.singleGlyphTradeoff: A single completely verified 阿 can justify this bounded source branch because existing schemas cannot represent its evidence. Avoid a generic source-framework rewrite, a new donor system or speculative entries. No infrastructure approval can resolve 兔 source disagreement.

downloadAndCacheAudit.currentCli: scripts/hanja-stroke-textbook-build.ts supports --manifest-file only for the pinned Vivasam XLSX. It still downloads all three pinned candidate corpora on each run and has no document or candidate-cache input flags.
downloadAndCacheAudit.currentSourceParser: scripts/hanja-stroke-textbook-source.py validates local or remote XLSX bytes against the fixed manifest SHA; it does not handle a PDF.
downloadAndCacheAudit.recommendedInput: A separate document builder/check may read a supplied existing source ZIP/PDF path read-only, or fetch the allowlisted official ZIP to RAM. Always verify exact SHA and byte size; a cache hit never skips verification. Keep source files outside the repository and do not auto-persist a download.
downloadAndCacheAudit.extraction: Extract the single named PDF entry in RAM with bounded compressed and expanded sizes. The exact PDF hash binds the reviewed page content; no PDF rendering or OCR is needed inside runtime delivery.
downloadAndCacheAudit.tls: The previous acquisition used platform curl with default TLS certificate verification because Bun/Node certificate-chain lookup failed. Never disable TLS verification. Do not introduce a blind unverified fallback.
downloadAndCacheAudit.candidateInput: Re-use the pinned corpus parser. Optional caller-supplied candidate files must pass the same complete-file SHA check, not merely the two selected records.

requiredImplementationValidation: Reject wrong document ID, URL, hash, page, glyph, byte size, panel count or missing initial stage.
Reject partial/pending/conflict records and foreign-direction substitution when the Korean order or form disagrees.
Reject missing/duplicate/out-of-range stroke mappings, source medians/recipe changes and altered final paths even when a caller updates only the output hash.
Reproduce the approved candidate geometry and final bundle with the actual generator; include only the completed glyph.
Retain the existing Vivasam tests unchanged, including rejection of missing videos and completion times.
Exercise general audit dispatch so the new source is counted as publisher evidence, never Eomunhoe evidence.
Compare all baseline1472 runtime entries and Vivasam969 public entries individually after integration; the old bundle SHA should remain unchanged for a separate bundle.
Run affected Hanja tests, typecheck, old Vivasam bundle --check, new document bundle --check and production build after implementation.
